effects: The signer (a guardian) records an approval for this exact recovery: wallet, newOwners, newThreshold and the Safe's current recovery nonce. Anyone can submit the signature through multiConfirmRecovery.
When enough guardians approve, anyone can start the recovery. Finalization is then possible after recoveryPeriod, which is 604800 s (7 days) on the verified mainnet deployment.
A new request with more approvals replaces a pending recovery request that had fewer approvals.
When the recovery is finalized, finalizeRecovery removes every current Safe owner, puts newOwners in their place and sets the Safe threshold to newThreshold.
The approval stays valid only while the Safe's recovery nonce stays the same. invalidateNonce, or a recovery that starts, makes it invalid.
No tokens or ETH of the signer move, and no allowance changes.
formats.shown: "Vote to recover Safe" / "Vote to make the new owners the only owners of {wallet}", with fields for the Safe, each new owner, the new threshold (raw) and a fixed 'Wait before takeover: 7 days'. The nonce is hidden.

findings.title: ExecuteRecovery interpolatedIntent says 'the new owners' but does not name them or the threshold.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json: "interpolatedIntent": "Vote to make the new owners the only owners of {wallet}". Case 0 renders "Vote to make the new owners the only owners of 0xff33cd67…2010" and the new owner 0x7e51332e…13f0 appears only in the fields. The spec allows wallets to show the interpolatedIntent in place of the field layout. In SocialRecoveryModule.finalizeRecovery, these addresses become the only Safe owners.
findings.fix: Put the first new owner and the count in the sentence, e.g. "Vote to make {newOwners[0]} (+ others, {newOwners.length} total) the only owners of {wallet}", or another form the runners support. Keep the per-owner field.
